description: Read Parfumo rankings: top rated by gender (men, women, unisex), newly added perfumes, 30-day trends (most collected, wished or worn), or perfumes released in a given year. Use for 'best of' or 'what is new' questions. Returns a paginated list of perfumes with rank when the site gives one.

oneOf.description: Perfumes most recently added to the database.
Trending: most added to collections over the last 30 days.
Trending: most wished for over the last 30 days.
Trending: most worn over the last 30 days.
Perfumes released in a given year (requires `year`).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor: the `next_cursor` of the previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 25, maximum 100).

name: parfumo_get_rankings

PerfumeSummary.description: A perfume as it appears in a listing (search, brand, ranking, similar).

concentration.description: Concentration or edition label shown next to the name (e.g. `Eau de Parfum`).

id.description: Stable identifier: `Brand/Perfume` URL slug, usable with every perfume tool.

p_id.description: Numeric Parfumo perfume id when the listing exposes it.

rank.description: Position in the ranking, when the listing is ranked.

rating.description: Average scent rating out of 10, when shown.

rating_count.description: Number of ratings behind `rating`, when shown.

reviews_count.description: Number of long reviews, when shown.

trend_count.description: Counter shown by trend rankings (collection adds, wishes or wears over the last 30 days).

url.description: Absolute Parfumo URL of the perfume page.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the following items. Absent when there is nothing more.

total_items.description: Total number of matching perfumes on Parfumo, when the site states it.
